description: This file contains the implementation for font management in a graphics or UI project, including loading fonts via FreeType, creating textures from font glyphs, rendering text, and managing font resources.

classes.name: lu5_font
classes.description: Structure representing a font, including glyph textures and font face data.

classes.name: lu5_State
classes.description: Structure holding the global state related to font rendering and FreeType initialization.

methods.name: void lu5_init_freetype(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Initializes the FreeType library within the given state object.

methods.name: int lu5_load_font(lu5_State * l5,lu5_font ** fontId,const char * fontPath)
methods.description: Loads a font from a given path or default font, creates textures for characters, and sets font size.

methods.name: lu5_font * lu5_load_and_add_font(lu5_State * l5,const char * font_path)
methods.description: Loads a new font and adds it to the font list in the state.

methods.name: void lu5_measure_text(const char * text,int * width,int * height,int * max_bearing_y,lu5_font * font)
methods.description: Measures the width, height, and maximum bearing Y of a text string using a specified font.

methods.name: void lu5_render_text(const char * text,float x,float y,float fontSize,int textAlign,lu5_font * font,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders text at specified position with given font size, alignment, and color.

methods.name: void lu5_load_default_font(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Loads the default font into the state.

methods.name: void lu5_close_font(lu5_font * font)
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with a font.

methods.name: void lu5_close_fonts(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Cleans up all fonts and the FreeType library from the state.
